reason: The README describes an fnOS desktop entry point that opens the DeepSeek Harness browser UI, with optional iframe presentation and access to a local Agent/bash environment; its primary user-facing purpose is desktop access to an external agent interface.

summaries.zh: 为 fnOS 提供打开 DeepSeek Harness 智能体浏览器界面的桌面入口，并支持在其 Agent/bash 环境中使用已声明的 Node.js 与 Bun 命令。
summaries.en: Provides an fnOS desktop entry point for the DeepSeek Harness agent browser interface, with access to declared Node.js and Bun commands in its Agent/bash environment.

capabilities: Opens the DeepSeek Harness web interface from fnOS
Provides an Agent/bash interface with access to declared Node.js and Bun command-line dependencies
